title: Locals Call It the World’s Largest Cesspool, and Blame It for Surging Cancer
summary_full: For decades, the Mexican authorities have sacrificed a rural valley to flush away the capital’s waste and power the economy. Now, local communities are paying for that decision — often with peoples’ lives.
